owner_statement: D-P5.4-PLAN-AUTH: I, mayank-admin, authorize planning, read-only repository analysis, and official primary-source research only for P5.4 Intelligence, Alerts, And Human Review. The authorized planning scope includes intelligence-analyst and mandatory-reviewer workflows; hypothesis and correlation-run queues; bounded relationship graphs and spatial projections with authoritative list and table alternatives; source observations, inferences, hypotheses, candidates, proposed alerts, reviews, corrections, and lifecycle states as visually and semantically distinct concepts; rule revision, evaluation, provenance, and explanation views; candidate uncertainty, calibration, contradiction, abstention, and field-minimized presentation; proposed-alert list, detail, priority, chronology, and lifecycle views; mandatory human review, configurable quorum, decision drafts, bounded reasons, confirmation, ETag concurrency, idempotency, conflict recovery, reconsideration, and correction workflows; event-driven invalidation with authoritative HTTP confirmation; department and role authorization; loading, empty, partial, stale, degraded, denied, conflict, failure, correction, and recovery states; low-resource, enhanced-workstation, control-room, GPU-lab, and future-server profiles without changing operator authority; accessibility and keyboard workflows; security, privacy, misuse, and overclaim threat analysis; dependency evaluation; generated-only fixtures and validation; producer-gap inventory; owner decision options; and a bounded P5.4 implementation and start plan. Planning must preserve the accepted Phase 3 analytics boundaries, Phase 4 intelligence, correlation, rule, alert, review, provider, and correction contracts, and the accepted Phase 5 shared application, Command/GIS, and camera/live foundations. The UI must never present a score, hypothesis, candidate, relationship, or proposed alert as confirmed identity, guilt, criminality, or operational truth. No review outcome may directly trigger notification, dispatch, enforcement, or another external action. Internet research is limited to official primary technical, security, privacy, accessibility, human-factors, API, event-contract, and standards sources. Local planning documentation, generated/static planning validation, and one local checkpoint commit without push are authorized. This does not authorize product or test implementation, source import, dependency installation or lockfile changes, backend routes or migrations, frontend or browser runtime, models, datasets, artifacts or inference, providers or network access, cameras or media, Government or private data, real investigations or identities, operational alerts, notifications, dispatch, enforcement or autonomous actions, containers, Kubernetes, deployment, P5.5, or remote Git.
